what.text: This page follows refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina living in Sweden, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 330 refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina in Sweden, 1.3% of all refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Serbia and Kosovo is the largest host of refugees from Bosnia and Herzegovina, followed by France and Denmark.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflicts in Bosnia-Herzegovina from 1992 to 1995, over Serb, Croat and Bihaca Krajina territory.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1993 to 2002, begin during those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 598 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 53435, at the end of 2002, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Sweden.
These are year-end totals for Sweden only, reported to UNHCR.
